finding_F80_THE_ENTRY_IS_A_QUESTION.claim: Tripadvisor's primary entry point is a question rather than a search field label.
finding_F80_THE_ENTRY_IS_A_QUESTION.supporting: Secondary heading: 'Busca cosas que hacer según tus intereses' (Search things to do according to your interests) — an interest-led rather than destination-led entry.
finding_F80_THE_ENTRY_IS_A_QUESTION.comparison: Booking.com's field reads 'Enter destination'. Expedia's reads 'Going to'. Airbnb's search chrome reads 'Cualquier lugar / Cualquier fecha' (Anywhere / Any date). Tripadvisor asks; the transactional products instruct.
finding_F80_THE_ENTRY_IS_A_QUESTION.why_it_matters: F-61 established that three competitors ASSERT the traveller's location and none asks. This is the same distinction at the other end: a product that opens with a question rather than a command. For a low-confidence user the difference between 'Enter destination' and 'Where are you going?' is small in words and large in posture.

finding_F81_DISCOVERY_IS_A_DESTINATION_N.claim: 'Descubrir' (Discover) is a top-level navigation item, alongside 'Opinión' (Review).
finding_F81_DISCOVERY_IS_A_DESTINATION_N.evidence: Primary nav: Descubrir · Opinión · Más. Vertical tabs: Cosas que hacer · Hoteles · Restaurantes.
finding_F81_DISCOVERY_IS_A_DESTINATION_N.why_it_matters: This confirms the roster rationale for Tripadvisor — it was included as the product assumed to lead with discovery rather than a search box, covering the scenario's stage 1 'Dream & discover'. It does. Discovery is a place you can go, not a state you pass through on the way to a search.

finding_F82_NO_FLIGHTS_VERTICAL.claim: Tripadvisor's primary verticals are things to do, hotels and restaurants. No flights vertical was present on the homepage.
finding_F82_NO_FLIGHTS_VERTICAL.why_it_matters_for_the_roster: Against the scenario's capability list, Tripadvisor covers activities and accommodation and does NOT cover flights or on-site transport. It is a stage-1 and stage-6 product — dream/discover and in-destination — with nothing in between. That is a narrower footprint than the roster tiering implied and should be carried into any capability matrix rather than assumed.
finding_F82_NO_FLIGHTS_VERTICAL.scope_limit: Homepage only. A flights surface may exist elsewhere on the site.

reviews_as_the_asset.verbatim_from_title: Tripadvisor: más de mil millones de opiniones y contribuciones sobre hoteles, atracciones, restaurantes
reviews_as_the_asset.translation: over a billion reviews and contributions
reviews_as_the_asset.note: The review corpus is stated as the product's identity in the page title itself. 'Opinión' is a primary nav item — the product invites CONTRIBUTION as a first-class action, which no other competitor captured does.
reviews_as_the_asset.prohibition_2_note: Competitor reviews are real people's words. Per CLAUDE.md and ART-024 section 5.4, review TEXT is never transcribed into any capture or the evidence ledger. The review MECHANISM is described; no review content is recorded.
